name: Space Explorers: Reload
source:
During blast-off of the spaceship one of the capsules got lost. The team found out that it was the one that contained all of their clothes. Now they all are about to go on a Space Exploring mission completely naked...

[From Steam (removed)]
translation:
在宇宙飞船发射期间，其中一个太空舱丢失了。团队发现这就是他们所有衣服的那一个。现在他们即将全裸地进行太空探索任务……

[来自Steam（已删除）]
